avis.texte: I love this sunscreen it's one of the best one out there it absorbs quickly into your skin not leaving a white cast like most and it leaves a glow which I really like on my skin. The only downside is rubbing your eyes and getting it in your eyes it burns it's annoying.

I have been on the hunt for a spf moisturizer that blends well with makeup, doesnt break me out, has no white cast, an gives me a glowly look. This is the product! Applies super easily and does a great job keeing my skin hydrated throughout the day.
I have been using the Innisfree sunscreen for a few years, but I decided to give this one a try and 10/10 recommend! No white cast, not greasy, no strong smell, this one is perfect!
It's perfect sunscreen is lightweight and don't leave any white cast in fact your face looks glowy and healthy. Love it for ever

Love this sunscreen! I am a natural redhead with fair, sensitive skin. I do not like super thick sunscreens, and this product is extremely lightweight and does not break my face out. It also does not have that strong sunscreen smell either.

I have acne prone combination skin so far I love it It's so moisturizing and doesn't feel super greasy on the skin absorbs really nicely no burning no white cast, but beware it does have fermented ingredients so it can cause breakouts.

This broke me out, unfortunately. I was looking for a sunscreen that was fragrance-free, had no white cast, and was lightweight. And this product has all of that, so when I used it, I was shocked when I broke out. I don't really have sensitive skin, so I imagine what this would do to someone with sensitive skin! I looked it up, and it may have been an allergic reaction. Still sucks though, I worked hard for my skin to be clear, just restart the skin care process, because of this sunscreen :(
